newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends steady, retains early edge.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends steady, retains early edge.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka retained early gains to close at 42.5470/5490 to the dollar in interbank trading against Tuesday's 42.5495/5500, dealers said.

"The market was not that active as we expected. Demand for the dollar slumped with some banks receiving fresh supply through remittances by Bangladeshis abroad. Deals totalled less than $5 million," said one dealer.
The taka was quoted at 42.5470/5490 in early trade.
Interbank call money rates finished flat at 4.5 percent to 6.0 percent, dealers said.
